guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 水電灌溉抽水與大型機組更新介面。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Hydropower irrigation pumping and major unit renewal interfaces. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 灌溉抽水設施於1951年完成，屬官方分期建設紀錄
1933 年官方紀錄：大古力工程開始施工，之後抽水及發電設施分期擴展
假想教材：灌溉抽水能量帳；rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW
假想教材：發電抽水淨交換；Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW
假想教材：前池水位緩衝；Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m
假想教材：輸水管摩阻尺度；f=0.018 (dimensionless); L=900 m; D=4 m; v=3 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f*(L/D)*v*v/(2*g)=1.857798165 m
factsEn: The irrigation pumping plant was completed in 1951, an official staged construction record
1933 official record: Grand Coulee construction begins, followed by staged pumping and generating development
Hypothetical teaching: Irrigation pumping energy account; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW
Hypothetical teaching: Generation pumping net exchange; Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW
Hypothetical teaching: Forebay level buffering; Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m
Hypothetical teaching: Conveyance friction scaling; f=0.018 (dimensionless); L=900 m; D=4 m; v=3 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; hf=f*(L/D)*v*v/(2*g)=1.857798165 m
timeline: 1933　大古力工程開始施工，之後抽水及發電設施分期擴展
1987　墾務局監測手冊出版，這是參考文獻年代而非本壩施工年份
2026　本課核對公開來源並重算原創假想模型，屬教材修訂日期
timelineEn: 1933 — Grand Coulee construction begins, followed by staged pumping and generating development
1987 — Reclamation instrumentation manuals are published; this dates references rather than construction of this dam
2026 — This course verifies public references and recomputes original hypothetical models, a curriculum revision date
codes: 美國墾務局大壩監測手冊，混凝土或土石壩依型式選讀
美國墾務局小壩設計手冊，僅作方法比較而非大型工程核准準則
codesEn: Reclamation Dam Instrumentation Manuals, select concrete or embankment according to dam type
Reclamation Design of Small Dams, comparative methods rather than approval criteria for this major project
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：大古力水壩
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Grand Coulee Dam
guides.concept: 大古力案例將發電與灌溉抽水放入同一能量和水量帳，並追蹤前池水位、管路阻力與機組停機如何相互影響。課程接續混凝土分塊、基礎排水與量測基準，再以灌溉回歸流及更新後效率驗證收束；學員須解釋不同時間尺度的資料為何不能直接相減。
guides.conceptEn: The Grand Coulee case places generation and irrigation pumping in one water and energy account and follows interactions among forebay level, pipe resistance and outages. Concrete blocks, foundation drainage and survey reference control lead into irrigation return flows and post-renewal efficiency verification. Learners explain why observations from different time scales cannot simply be subtracted.
procedure: 發電廠與抽水站共用水資源時，抽水所需能量不能從發電流量直接相減。抽水揚程包含上下游能量高程差與管路損失，電端輸入還需除以泵及馬達效率。先把取水量、提高的位能與耗電分列，才能比較不同灌溉時程的水能代價。 若以每立方米耗電比較方案，應將功率除流量並正確換算能量單位，才能消除單純抽水規模不同的影響。
電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。不同設備的電表可能位於變壓器前後，必須統一計量邊界再作加減。水量帳也需另列，因取水到灌區的時間延遲不等於電力交換時段。 輔機可能由外部電網供電而非機組母線供電，淨外送與自用電帳必須依實際接線拓撲定義。
前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。矩形水池的面積模型適合建立短時反應尺度；若池形變化大、波浪明顯或連接渠道長，則需把儲存與傳播分開，不能把所有測點當成同時同高。 渠道水面振盪能使局部水位先升後降而總儲量近乎不變，多站平均與流量積分提供不同但互補的資訊。
灌溉輸水損失隨流速增大而快速上升，達西摩阻式把管長、直徑與粗糙影響放在同一能量帳。摩阻因子並非固定材料常數，會受雷諾數及相對粗糙度控制。教材固定因子只為隔離流速效應，實際比較前必須核對流況與局部構件。 截面直徑改變也會改變速度水頭，壓力差不全是耗散，必須先扣除可逆的動能與高程變化。
從水庫取出的水不全等於流域消耗，部分可能在不同時間和位置回到河道。課程把取水、作物蒸散、渠道蒸發、地下儲存與回歸流分開，先建立明確邊界的日帳。回歸水水質與到達時間也可能限制再利用，不能只靠體積差評價灌溉效益。 回歸水若跨越原先劃定邊界，需改列外部輸出而非區內儲存，控制體選擇會改變各項名稱但不改守恆。
相鄰壩塊不同的溫度歷程會造成相容變形差，而不是每塊都在相同溫度下同步收縮。教材比較兩塊的自由熱應變差，作為接縫運動的來源之一；澆置齡期、徐變與約束會改變實際應力，因此應變差不能直接乘一個彈性模數就宣告開裂。 兩塊混凝土即使最終溫度相同，也可能因不同齡期的約束與徐變而留下不同殘餘應力，不能只比較終值。
排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。簡化的導水率乘水頭差模型可描述一段線性滲流路徑，但岩體裂隙網絡可能隨壓力改變。壓力與流量必須成對觀察，才可區分堵塞及新增滲流。 導水率的單位是面積每時間，與材料滲透係數的長度每時間不同，兩者還差流路幾何因子。
大型機組檢修會降低可用發電通道，但不一定同比例降低河道總出流，因其他機組及放流設施可能分擔水量。教材先用可用機組數乘假定單機出力估算容量，再把水頭、流量與共同輸電限制另列。設備容量是上限條件之一，不能單獨預測實際電量。 未被發電利用的水可能仍履行必要河道放流，因此旁通量應記入水量帳，而非自動視為可避免的浪費。
壩體沉陷、庫水位與設備高程若使用不同基準，量測之間會出現看似物理的差異。水準閉合差用來檢查測線一致性，卻不能證明所有基準點都穩定；整組點共同移動時，內部閉合仍可能良好，因此必須連到獨立且可追溯的控制點。 觀測線長度與視距不平衡會影響誤差來源，配賦方式應依量測品質而非僅按測段數平均處理。
機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。先以同一水力輸入估算效率增加帶來的功率差，再討論不確定度與測試重複性。額定出力提高與日常效率提高是不同主張，需要不同驗證資料。 全年收益需以各工況停留時間加權，單一最佳效率點的改善不能代表全年不同水頭流量下的平均成效。
procedureEn: When generation and irrigation pumping share a water resource, pumping energy cannot be subtracted directly from generating discharge. Pump head includes the difference in energy elevations and conveyance losses, while electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump and motor efficiency. Separate water volume, gained potential energy and electricity before comparing irrigation schedules. Comparing energy per cubic metre requires dividing power by flow with consistent energy units, separating scale of pumping from the underlying hydraulic and efficiency effects.

Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. Meters may sit on different sides of transformers, requiring a common boundary. Maintain a separate water account because delivery time to irrigation areas differs from the electrical exchange interval. Auxiliaries may draw from an external grid rather than the generating bus, so net export and internal consumption depend on the actual electrical connection topology.

A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions. A constant-area model establishes a short-term response scale. Strongly varying geometry, waves or long connecting canals require separate treatment of storage and propagation instead of assuming every gauge changes simultaneously. Surface oscillation can raise and lower a local level with little total storage change; multi-gauge averages and flow integration provide distinct complementary information.

Conveyance loss rises rapidly with velocity, and Darcy-Weisbach places length, diameter and roughness effects in one energy account. The friction factor is not a fixed material property; Reynolds number and relative roughness matter. Holding it constant isolates velocity effects for teaching, while field comparisons require flow-regime and fitting checks. A diameter change also changes velocity head, so pressure difference is not entirely dissipation; first account for reversible kinetic and elevation-energy changes between sections.

Water withdrawn from a reservoir is not identical to basin consumption because some returns at another time and location. Separate withdrawal, crop evapotranspiration, canal evaporation, subsurface storage and return flow within a declared daily boundary. Return-water quality and arrival time can constrain reuse even when the volume account closes. Return water crossing the chosen boundary is an external output rather than internal storage; control-volume choice changes labels while preserving the conservation requirement.

Neighboring blocks can have different thermal histories and therefore different free strains rather than cooling together. Their free thermal-strain difference is one source of joint movement. Placement age, creep and restraint alter actual stress, so multiplying this difference by one elastic modulus does not by itself establish cracking. Two blocks reaching the same final temperature may retain different stresses because restraint and creep developed at different ages; matching endpoints does not establish equivalent histories.

Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. Conductance times head difference describes one linear seepage path, while a fractured-rock network may change with pressure. Pressure and flow must be observed together to distinguish blockage from newly connected seepage. Hydraulic conductance has area-per-time units, unlike conductivity in length per time; a flow-path geometry factor is required before one can be converted into the other.

A major-unit outage reduces available generating paths without necessarily reducing total river release proportionally, because other units and outlets may carry water. Count available units at an assumed unit output first, then consider head, discharge and shared transmission constraints. Equipment capacity is only one limit and cannot independently predict energy production. Water bypassing turbines may still satisfy required river release; account for its volume without automatically treating all bypass as an avoidable operational waste.

Dam settlement, reservoir level and equipment elevation can appear inconsistent when different reference datums are used. Level-loop closure tests internal consistency but cannot establish that every benchmark is stable. A group of points moving together can still close well, so an independent traceable control point is needed to interpret movement. Line length and unequal sight distances affect survey errors; adjustment weights should reflect observation quality rather than distributing every closure equally by number of legs.

A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement. Estimate the power difference for one hydraulic input, then examine uncertainty and repeatability. Increased rated output and improved routine efficiency are distinct claims requiring different supporting observations. Annual benefit requires weighting operating points by their duration; improvement at one best-efficiency point does not represent average performance across a year of varying conditions.
evidence: 固定輸送體積，分別比較高水位短時抽水與低水位長時抽水的總耗電，列出效率及管路阻力資料，避免只用尖峰功率選方案。
為三種抽水時程計算日淨外送電量，並讓總抽水量相同，說明電價時序、灌溉需求與設備效率各需何種附加資料才能比較。
將緩衝面積減半並改成兩段出流，逐段計算水位，畫出泵啟動前後的測站佈置，指出何時常面積模型不再足夠。
把流量提高兩成，在直徑不變下重算流速與摩阻，再增加一個已知局部損失係數，分別列出兩種損失對總揚程的貢獻。
加入一日延遲的回歸流，建立連續三日水量表，再比較單日與三日淨消耗，提出一項能檢查地下儲存變化的現地觀測。
evidenceEn: For a fixed delivered volume, compare short pumping at a high source level with longer pumping at a low level. List efficiency and resistance data needed before choosing a schedule from peak power alone.

Calculate daily net export for three pumping schedules with equal delivered water. Explain the additional price timing, irrigation-demand and equipment-efficiency information needed to compare their practical consequences.

Halve the buffering area and use two successive outflows. Compute the level segment by segment, locate gauges around pump starting, and identify observations that would invalidate the constant-area model.

Increase flow by twenty percent at unchanged diameter and recalculate velocity and friction. Add one known local-loss coefficient and separately account for each contribution to the total pumping head.

Add a one-day delay to return flow and construct a three-day balance. Compare daily and cumulative consumption, then propose a field observation that can test the inferred change in subsurface storage.
pitfalls: 進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。
前池太小可能讓短時抽水不平衡造成快速降水位，影響進水淹沒深度；感測器若設在局部流速大處，也會把動壓效應誤當成整池儲量下降。
將深層滲漏一律稱為浪費，可能忽略可回收地下水；但把所有滲漏都視為可利用回歸流也會高估供水，因水質、流向與時間均可能不符合需求。
排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。
自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。
pitfallsEn: An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. Different meter integration windows can also create a false efficiency change and must be checked before diagnosing the pump.

Insufficient buffering can make a short pumping imbalance lower the level quickly and reduce intake submergence. A sensor in a high-velocity zone can also mistake local dynamic effects for a loss of storage throughout the forebay.

Calling all deep percolation waste can ignore recoverable groundwater. Treating it all as usable return flow can equally overstate supply because water quality, direction and arrival time may fail to match the downstream demand.

An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. Blockage in the measuring tube instead produces a delayed response and needs an independent response test to identify.

Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. If the reference benchmark itself responds to reservoir loading, all relative elevations can shift together while remaining internally consistent and apparently precise.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 伊泰普水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「灌溉抽水能量帳」與「基礎排水阻力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；伊泰普水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Irrigation pumping energy account" and "Foundation drainage resistance" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Itaipu Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦水電灌溉抽水與大型機組更新介面；伊泰普水壩則以雙頻率水電系統與跨境能量協調為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hydropower irrigation pumping and major unit renewal interfaces; Itaipu Dam centres on dual frequency hydropower and cross border energy coordination, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「灌溉抽水能量帳」與「頻率極數與轉速」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到伊泰普水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「轉子激振頻率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Irrigation pumping energy account” and “Frequency poles and speed”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Itaipu Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rotor excitation frequency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大古力水壩
history.text: 墾務局施工史記載大古力工程於一九三三年開始，第一批混凝土在一九三五年澆置，灌溉抽水設施於一九五一年完成。這些分期事件提醒學員：攔河壩、發電與灌溉系統不是同一天形成的單一設備。本課以此分期背景研究接口責任與守恆，並不聲稱假想流量等於現場抽水量。監測手冊出版年代另列為知識背景，二〇二六年的來源核對也與歷史建設明確區分。
history.textEn: Reclamation construction history places the start of Grand Coulee in 1933, the first concrete in 1935 and completion of the irrigation pumping plant in 1951. These stages show that the dam, generation and irrigation systems did not arrive as one device on one date. The course uses that sequence to examine interfaces and conservation, without identifying assumed flows as field pumping records. Instrumentation publication dates describe reference history, and the 2026 source check is distinguished from construction.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「灌溉抽水能量帳」到「更新效率比較」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Irrigation pumping energy account" through "Post renewal efficiency comparison" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
